name: What factors determine the cost of repairing bathroom drywall?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of repairing bathroom drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends mainly on the scope of water damage, the size of the repair area, and the required finish work. Minor hole patches cost significantly less than replacing saturated sheets, treating hidden mold, or reframing warped studs behind a shower. A primary factor that changes the overall estimate is whether plumbing fixtures, vanities, or tile need removal and reinstallation to access the damaged wall cavity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the damage size, whether underlying framing or plumbing needs attention, and if fixtures or tiles must be removed to replace the affected drywall properly.
